occlusionAdjustmentPolicy.reason: Independent read-only original source renders and canonical-aspect ray visibility diagnostics show the existing camera-ray bias leaves a false-mouth plate overlay at the rear head for both foods. Dependency/aspect replacement alone cannot satisfy visible no-crescent requirement.
occlusionAdjustmentPolicy.allowed: Only the food display XYZ location drivers camera-ray offset may gain a single smooth semantic-orientation law. One shared function and one object-specific calibrated depth parameter for salmon and cucumber, across every action/frame. No per-frame, per-food or per-view fitting.
occlusionAdjustmentPolicy.law: Let f be the dot product of normalized semantic ground-forward and the fixed camera horizontal direction. Let d0 be the actual existing camera-ray bias. d(f)=d0-(d0-dMin)*max(0,-f)^2, with 0<=dMin<=d0. Preserve the existing bias exactly for the front and side half-plane; continuously reduce it in the rear half-plane. Measure coordinate conventions from this source; do not import Rowan constants.
occlusionAdjustmentPolicy.registration: Original physical palm trajectory, root, actions, rig and semantic pose remain exact. Food display width/full canonical UV/aspect stay fixed. Every food quad and plate-bottom projected vertex must remain within0.001 native pixel of the same-size canonical v2 baseline for all192 main+96 cucumber frames; all shipping world displacement must be collinear with the actual fixed camera ray within measured native float precision; intermediate-angle continuity is judged against the correct analytic ray with old snapping residual explicitly reported. The 3D display offset can change only along this ray; do not claim unchanged world food-plane positions.
occlusionAdjustmentPolicy.continuity: C1 continuous at the forward/side boundary, one continuous native expression, no facing switches or discrete keys. Audit representative intermediate root angles around the transition as well as all shipping frames. Avoid driver FCurve numerical snapping; validate actual evaluated transforms and expression mapping.
occlusionAdjustmentPolicy.visibleGoal: No false-face plate crescent or isolated plate/rice remnants on the rear head in either food through every hold/load phase. Natural coherent body occlusion is acceptable; exposed views retain salmon or cucumber identity, rice/plate and stable hand contact without new important occlusion.
occlusionAdjustmentPolicy.immutable: Approved physical body/knife/evaluated meshes/normals/rig/actions/root/light/material/camera, food image/shader/filtering/colorspace/visibility/yaw cancellation, all output clip/timing/layout contracts and all prior artifacts. No renderer change, screen-space patch, target regeneration or body edits.
occlusionAdjustmentPolicy.numericalDriverMapping: Only food XYZ location-driver identity mappings may replace legacy BEZIER keyed FCurves with an exact polynomial identity0+1*x if needed to implement the continuous analytic camera-ray law. Preserve original food yaw driver/mapping and every other controller. All288 shipping projected-quad/bottom comparisons remain<=0.001 native px against the original same-size canonical baseline; shipping displacement must be collinear within measured native float precision. At intermediate nonshipping angles, the new mapping must follow the analytic camera ray and be C1 continuous. Quantify the old keyed-source off-ray snapping residual separately; bitwise identity to that defective intermediate mapping is not required and must not be claimed.
